intro.lede: Every book below is real, and every link goes somewhere. Nothing here was assembled from memory: each title was checked against a publisher, a university press catalogue or a library record before it went on the list.
intro.findNote: The Find it link searches Open Library by ISBN where one exists and by title otherwise. It will not go dead. Where a book is legally free to read in full, a second link goes straight to it.
intro.outOfPrint: A good number of these are out of print, some of them badly so. That is the state of the field rather than a defect in the list. Isenberg's sourcebook and Musleah's history of Calcutta Jewry are among the most useful books here and among the hardest to get.

categories.label: Baghdadi Jews
categories.blurb: Calcutta, Bombay, and a trading network that ran to Shanghai.

categories.label: Bnei Menashe and the north east
categories.blurb: The most recent migration and the most contested claim.

categories.label: India and Israel
categories.blurb: Diplomacy, defence and the forty-two year gap. Includes work critical of the relationship.

categories.label: Gandhi, Nehru and the Jewish question
categories.blurb: What the national movement said about Zionism, and to whom.

categories.label: Fiction, memoir and poetry
categories.blurb: Written by Indian Jews, mostly about being Indian Jews.

categories.label: Food, music, art and objects
categories.blurb: The parts of a culture that survive migration in a suitcase.

categories.blurb: Grammars, courses and dictionaries, ancient and modern.

categories.label: Learning Hindi and Devanagari
categories.blurb: Grammars, courses and the two great historical dictionaries.

books.title: Who Are the Jews of India?
books.author: Nathan Katz
books.note: The standard scholarly overview of all three historic communities and how they negotiated Jewish identity inside Hindu society.

books.title: Jews in British India: Identity in a Colonial Era
books.author: Joan G. Roland
books.note: Landmark archival history of the Bene Israel, Cochin and Baghdadi communities under the Raj.

books.title: The Jewish Communities of India: Identity in a Colonial Era
books.author: Joan G. Roland
books.note: Revised reissue of Roland's 1989 study, carried up to the 1990s.

books.title: India's Jewish Heritage: Ritual, Art and Life-Cycle
books.author: Shalva Weil, editor
books.note: Illustrated multi-author volume on religious life, art and life-cycle custom.

books.title: Jews and India: Perceptions and Image
books.author: Yulia Egorova
books.note: How Indian intellectuals, nationalists and Hindutva writers have imagined Jews and Israel.

books.title: Jews and Muslims in South Asia: Reflections on Difference, Religion, and Race
books.author: Yulia Egorova
books.note: Comparative study of how Jewishness and Muslimness are built as minority categories.

books.title: Indo-Judaic Studies in the Twenty-First Century
books.author: Katz, Chakravarti, Sinha and Weil, editors
books.note: The collection that defined the field, from ancient trade to modern diplomacy.

books.title: The Jews of India
books.author: Benjamin J. Israel
books.note: Concise insider survey by a Bene Israel civil servant and community historian.

books.title: Jews in India
books.author: Thomas A. Timberg, editor
books.note: Early anthology on all the communities. Out of print and freely readable online.

books.title: Western Jews in India: From the Fifteenth Century to the Present
books.author: Robbins and Tokayer, editors
books.note: European and Middle Eastern Jews who settled in or passed through India.

books.title: Studies of Indian Jewish Identity
books.author: Nathan Katz, editor
books.note: Anthropological and historical essays on how Indian Jews defined themselves.

books.title: Jews and India: Mutual Influences over Two Millennia
books.author: Nathan Katz
books.note: Katz's late synthesis of two thousand years of contact.

books.title: Indian Jews: An Annotated Bibliography 1665-2005
books.author: Nathan Katz
books.note: The reference bibliography. If you are researching this seriously, start here.

books.title: Jewish Communities in Exotic Places
books.author: Ken Blady
books.note: Popular survey with substantial chapters on all three Indian communities.

books.title: Between Jerusalem and Benares: Comparative Studies in Judaism and Hinduism
books.author: Hananya Goodman, editor
books.publisher: State University of New York Press
books.note: The volume that launched academic Hindu-Jewish comparison.

books.title: Veda and Torah: Transcending the Textuality of Scripture
books.author: Barbara A. Holdrege
books.publisher: State University of New York Press
books.note: Major comparative study of scripture and cosmology in Brahmanical and rabbinic traditions.

books.title: Rabbi on the Ganges: A Jewish-Hindu Encounter
books.author: Alan Brill
books.note: Contemporary theological survey of Jewish encounters with Hinduism.

books.title: India Traders of the Middle Ages: Documents from the Cairo Geniza
books.author: S. D. Goitein and Mordechai A. Friedman
books.note: The Geniza letters of medieval Jewish merchants trading with Malabar and Gujarat.

books.title: Abraham's Luggage: A Social Life of Things in the Medieval Indian Ocean World
books.author: Elizabeth A. Lambourn
books.note: A whole book built from one twelfth century packing list of a Jewish trader sailing to India.

books.title: Jewish Exile in India 1933-1945
books.author: Anil Bhatti and Johannes H. Voigt, editors
books.note: The German-speaking Jewish refugees who found shelter in colonial India.

books.title: Letters to Auntie Fori: The 5,000-Year History of the Jewish People and Their Faith
books.author: Martin Gilbert
books.note: Jewish history as letters to Fori Nehru, the Hungarian Jewish wife of an Indian diplomat.

books.title: India's Bene Israel: A Comprehensive Inquiry and Sourcebook
books.author: Shirley Berry Isenberg
books.publisher: Judah L. Magnes Museum and Popular Prakashan
books.note: The indispensable documentary sourcebook. Out of print and expensive secondhand.

books.title: The Children of Israel: The Bene Israel of Bombay
books.author: Schifra Strizower
books.note: Social anthropology of the community in its last decades as a large Bombay presence.

books.title: The History of the Bene Israel of India
books.author: Haeem Samuel Kehimkar
books.note: The community's own foundational history, written 1897 and published posthumously. Free online.

books.title: The Bene Israel of India: Some Studies
books.author: Benjamin J. Israel
books.note: Careful essays on origins, caste position and religious practice.

books.title: Bene Israel of India: Heritage and Customs
books.author: Nissim Moses, compiler
books.note: Large illustrated community compendium of custom, genealogy and biography.

books.title: The Jews of Andhra Pradesh: Contesting Caste and Religion in South India
books.author: Yulia Egorova and Shahid Perwez
books.note: Ethnography of the Bene Ephraim, Dalit villagers who claim Israelite descent.

books.title: Being Indian, Being Israeli: Migration, Ethnicity and Gender in the Jewish Homeland
books.author: Maina Chawla Singh
books.note: Oral history of Bene Israel and Cochin migrants and their children in Israel.

books.title: On a Chariot of Fire: The Story of India's Bene Israel
books.author: Erica Lyons, illustrated by Siona Benjamin
books.note: The shipwreck origin story for children, illustrated by a Bene Israel painter.

books.title: Jewish Heritage of the Deccan: Mumbai, the Northern Konkan and Pune
books.author: Robbins and Sohoni, editors
books.note: The synagogues, cemeteries and built heritage of the Bene Israel heartland.

books.title: The Last Jews of Cochin: Jewish Identity in Hindu India
books.author: Nathan Katz and Ellen S. Goldberg
books.note: The standard ethnography of the Paradesi and Malabari Jews in their final generation.

books.title: Kashrut, Caste and Kabbalah: The Religious Life of the Jews of Cochin
books.author: Nathan Katz and Ellen S. Goldberg
books.note: Cochin Jewish ritual, dietary law and mystical practice.

books.title: A History of the Jews of Cochin
books.author: J. B. Segal
books.note: Documentary history from the copper plates onward, by a Semitic philologist.

books.title: Ruby of Cochin: An Indian Jewish Woman Remembers
books.author: Ruby Daniel and Barbara C. Johnson
books.note: The first book by a Cochin Jewish woman, written from a kibbutz in the Galilee.

books.title: The Last Jews of Kerala
books.author: Edna Fernandes
books.note: Journalism on the surviving Kerala Jews and the Paradesi and Malabari caste division.

books.title: The Jews of Kerala
books.author: P. M. Jussay
books.note: Collected essays by a scholar who spent decades documenting local Jewish tradition.

books.title: The Jewish Gandhi of Cochin
books.author: Bala Menon and Essie Sassoon
books.note: A. B. Salem, the Cochin Jewish lawyer, nationalist and anti-caste campaigner, with his assembly speeches.

books.title: One Heart. Two Worlds. The Story of the Jews of Kochi
books.author: K. S. Mathew and Yamini Nair
books.note: Illustrated documentary book on the history and remaining sites of Kochi Jewry.

books.title: The Songs of the Jews of Cochin and Their Historical Significance
books.author: A. I. Simon
books.note: Early local study of the Judeo-Malayalam song tradition.

books.title: The Baghdadi Jews in India
books.author: Shalva Weil, editor
books.note: The current scholarly reference on the Baghdadi communities of Bombay and Calcutta.

books.title: Jewish Portraits, Indian Frames: Women's Narratives from a Diaspora of Hope
books.author: Jael Silliman
books.note: Four generations of Calcutta Baghdadi women, through family narrative and archive.

books.title: On the Banks of the Ganga: The Sojourn of Jews in Calcutta
books.author: Ezekiel N. Musleah
books.note: Community history by the last rabbi of Calcutta.

books.title: Turning Back the Pages: A Chronicle of Calcutta Jewry
books.author: Esmond David Ezra
books.note: Two volume family and community chronicle drawn from Ezra family papers.

books.title: Jews of the Raj
books.author: Mavis Hyman
books.note: Social history of the Baghdadi communities, written from inside the community.

books.title: The Jews of Calcutta: The Autobiography of a Community 1798-1972
books.author: Flower Elias and Judith Elias Cooper
books.note: Community-published documentary history. Scarce.

books.title: The Sassoon Dynasty
books.author: Cecil Roth
books.note: The first scholarly biography of the family that dominated Bombay's opium and cotton trade. Free online.

books.title: The Sassoons: Portrait of a Dynasty
books.author: Stanley Jackson
books.note: Popular narrative history from Baghdad to Bombay to London.

books.title: The Sassoons: The Great Global Merchants and the Making of an Empire
books.author: Joseph Sassoon
books.note: Modern archive history using the family's own Hebrew and Judeo-Arabic papers.

books.title: The Last Kings of Shanghai
books.author: Jonathan Kaufman
books.note: The Sassoons and Kadoories, from Baghdad and Bombay to Shanghai and Hong Kong.

books.title: Shanghai's Baghdadi Jews
books.author: Maisie J. Meyer
books.note: Biographies tracing the Bombay and Calcutta roots of the Shanghai community.

books.title: Across the Sabbath River: In Search of a Lost Tribe of Israel
books.author: Hillel Halkin
books.note: Narrative investigation of the Kuki-Chin-Mizo claim, by a sympathetic sceptic.

books.title: The Lost Tribes of Israel: The History of a Myth
books.author: Tudor Parfitt
books.note: Critical history of lost tribe theories, including the north east Indian case.

books.title: Judaising Movements: Studies in the Margins of Judaism in Modern Times
books.author: Parfitt and Trevisan Semi, editors
books.note: Comparative essays on groups adopting Judaism, with chapters on the Bnei Menashe.

books.title: Jews, Judaizing Movements and the Traditions of Israelite Descent in South Asia
books.author: Navras Jaat Aafreedi
books.note: Survey of every South Asian claimant of Israelite descent.

books.title: The Tribes of Israel: The Lost and the Dispersed
books.author: Eliyahu Avichail
books.note: The founding text of the rabbi who located and named the Bnei Menashe. Advocacy, not scholarship.

books.title: Israel-Mizo Identity
books.author: Zaithanchhungi
books.note: Locally published Mizo argument for Israelite origins, widely cited in the literature.

books.title: India's Israel Policy
books.author: P. R. Kumaraswamy
books.note: The fullest account of why India waited until 1992, and what changed.

books.title: The Evolution of India's Israel Policy
books.author: Nicolas Blarel
books.note: Archive-based reinterpretation stressing domestic politics and incremental change since the 1920s.

books.title: India and Israel: The Making of a Strategic Partnership
books.author: Prasad and Rajiv, editors
books.note: Defence, technology and diplomacy in the relationship after 1992.

books.title: The India-Israel Strategic Partnership
books.author: S. Samuel C. Rajiv
books.note: Detailed institute study of the defence and security relationship. Free as a PDF.

books.title: Hostile Homelands: The New Alliance Between India and Israel
books.author: Azad Essa
books.note: Critical polemic linking Hindutva and Zionism, comparing Kashmir with Palestine. Read it precisely because it argues the other way.

books.title: India and the Middle East
books.author: Prithvi Ram Mudiam
books.note: Pre-normalisation study, useful for the Nehru and Indira years.

books.title: West Asia and the Region: Defining India's Role
books.author: Rajendra M. Abhyankar
books.note: Practitioner's survey by a former Indian ambassador.

books.title: Israel-Asia Relations in the Twenty-First Century
books.author: Evron and Kowner, editors
books.note: Places the India relationship inside Israel's wider Asian pivot.

books.title: Beyond the Veil: Israel-Pakistan Relations
books.author: P. R. Kumaraswamy
books.note: The covert side of the subcontinental triangle. Free as a PDF.

books.title: From India to Palestine: Essays in Solidarity
books.author: Githa Hariharan, editor
books.note: Indian writers and activists on the older tradition of Indian support for Palestine.

books.title: India's Policy Towards West Asia: The Modi Era
books.author: Chinoy and Pradhan, editors
books.note: Recent institute volume on the recalibration of regional policy. Free as a PDF.

books.title: India's Approach to West Asia: Trends, Challenges and Possibilities
books.author: Chinoy and Pradhan, editors
books.note: Companion volume covering the Gulf, Iran, Israel and the Palestinian question.

books.title: India and the Arab Unrest
books.author: Prasanta Kumar Pradhan
books.note: How the Arab uprisings reshaped India's balancing act.

books.title: India and Israel: Towards Strategic Partnership
books.author: K. Gopal and S. Sharma, editors
books.note: Indian collection on the emerging partnership after normalisation.

books.title: India and World Politics: Krishna Menon's View of the World
books.author: Michael Brecher
books.note: Interview portrait of Nehru's closest foreign policy adviser, including his position on Israel.

books.title: Squaring the Circle: Mahatma Gandhi and the Jewish National Home
books.author: P. R. Kumaraswamy
books.note: Close reading of what Gandhi actually wrote about Zionism, and when.

books.title: Gandhi and the Middle East: Jews, Arabs and Imperial Interests
books.author: Simone Panter-Brick
books.note: Gandhi's positions on Palestine against the pressure of Indian Muslim opinion and empire.

books.title: Gandhi and Nationalism: The Path to Indian Independence
books.author: Simone Panter-Brick
books.note: Context for his stance on Jewish nationhood.

books.title: Gandhi and his Jewish Friends
books.author: Margaret Chatterjee
books.note: Kallenbach, Polak, Schlesin and the Jewish circle around Gandhi in South Africa.

books.title: Soulmates: The Story of Mahatma Gandhi and Hermann Kallenbach
books.author: Shimon Lev
books.note: Gandhi's closest Jewish friend, from newly available Kallenbach papers.

books.title: The Breakup of India and Palestine
books.author: Kattan and Ranjan, editors
books.note: The two partitions of 1947 and 1948, and their entangled legacies.

books.title: In the Shadow of the Swastika
books.author: Marzia Casolari
books.note: Hindu nationalist engagement with fascism. Essential background to Indian views of Jews in the 1930s.

books.title: Collected Poems
books.author: Nissim Ezekiel, edited by John Thieme
books.note: The complete poems of the man who made English a working literary language for Indian writers.

books.title: Latter-Day Psalms
books.author: Nissim Ezekiel
books.note: The Sahitya Akademi winner, in which he rewrites the Psalms.

books.title: The Walled City
books.author: Esther David
books.note: Three generations of a Bene Israel family in Ahmedabad.

books.title: Book of Esther
books.author: Esther David
books.note: Family saga from village Konkan to modern Gujarat.

books.title: Book of Rachel
books.author: Esther David
books.note: An ageing woman guarding the last synagogue of a Konkan village. Sahitya Akademi Award, 2010.

books.title: Shalom India Housing Society
books.author: Esther David
books.note: Linked stories in an Ahmedabad housing block after the 2002 riots.

books.title: Bombay Brides
books.author: Esther David
books.note: Matchmaking and marriage in a shrinking community.

books.title: Dropped from Heaven: Stories
books.author: Sophie Judah
books.note: Nineteen linked stories in the invented Bene Israel town of Jwalanagar.

books.title: The Girl from Foreign
books.author: Sadia Shepard
books.note: A writer discovers her grandmother was Bene Israel, and goes to India to find the community.

books.title: The Man with Many Hats
books.author: Jael Silliman
books.note: Calcutta Baghdadi life, by the community's leading chronicler.

books.title: Sharp Blue Search of Flame
books.author: Zilka Joseph
books.note: Poems on Bene Israel identity, migration and belonging.

books.title: Miss Samuel: A Jewish-Indian Saga
books.author: Sheela Rohekar, translated by Madhu Singh
books.note: The only Hindi novel about Indian Jews, in English at last. Written in Hindi in 2013.

books.title: Heat and Dust
books.author: Ruth Prawer Jhabvala
books.note: Booker winner by the German-born Jewish writer who spent twenty-four years in India.

books.title: The Jews of India: A Story of Three Communities
books.author: Orpa Slapak, editor
books.note: The Israel Museum catalogue. Still the best visual record of Indian Jewish objects and dress.

books.title: Growing Up Jewish in India
books.author: Ori Z. Soltes, editor
books.note: Synagogue architecture, custom, and the art of Siona Benjamin.

books.title: Jews and the Indian National Art Project
books.author: Robbins and Tokayer, editors
books.note: Jewish artists, patrons and collectors in the making of modern Indian art.

books.title: Bene Appetit: The Cuisine of Indian Jews
books.author: Esther David
books.note: Recipes gathered from Bene Israel, Cochin, Baghdadi and Bnei Menashe kitchens. National Jewish Book Award.

books.title: Indian-Jewish Cooking
books.author: Mavis Hyman
books.note: Baghdadi kitchen practice from Calcutta and Bombay written down by a member of the community, which is most of what survives of that domestic world in print.

books.title: Spice and Kosher: Exotic Cuisine of the Cochin Jews
books.author: Sassoon, Menon and Salem
books.note: Kerala Jewish recipes with historical notes.

books.title: The Varied Kitchens of India
books.author: Copeland Marks
books.note: Contains one of the earliest published records of Calcutta Jewish cooking.

books.title: Shbahoth: Songs of Praise in the Babylonian Jewish Tradition
books.author: Sara Manasseh
books.note: The Baghdadi liturgical repertoire as it travelled from Baghdad to Bombay to London.

books.title: Songs of the Jews of Calcutta
books.author: Rahel Musleah
books.note: Liturgical and domestic songs of the Baghdadi community with transliteration, collected by a cantor's daughter from Calcutta.

books.title: Karkulali, Yefefiah, Gorgeous! Jewish Women's Songs in Malayalam
books.author: Gamliel and Zacharia, editors
books.note: Critical edition of the Judeo-Malayalam women's song notebooks of Kerala.

books.title: Oh, Lovely Parrot! Jewish Women's Songs from Kerala
books.author: Barbara C. Johnson, editor
books.publisher: Jewish Music Research Centre, Hebrew University
books.note: Recordings with a scholarly companion on Kerala Jewish women's singing.

books.title: Apples and Pomegranates: A Family Seder for Rosh Hashanah
books.author: Rahel Musleah
books.note: A Rosh Hashanah seder in the Baghdadi Indian form, from the same author, aimed at families rather than scholars.

books.title: The Grammar of Modern Hebrew
books.author: Lewis Glinert
books.note: The most thorough descriptive grammar of Israeli Hebrew in English.

books.title: Modern Hebrew: An Essential Grammar
books.author: Lewis Glinert
books.note: The compact learner's version. Start here if you are teaching yourself.

books.title: A Reference Grammar of Modern Hebrew
books.author: Coffin and Bolozky
books.note: Organised for learners and teachers rather than for linguists.

books.title: Hebrew from Scratch, Part 1
books.author: Chayat, Israeli and Kobliner
books.note: The standard Israeli ulpan textbook. Hebrew throughout, no English crutch, which is why it works and why it is hard at the start.

books.title: Colloquial Hebrew: The Complete Course for Beginners
books.author: Lyttleton and Wang
books.note: The gentler English language route in, with audio. Slower than an ulpan and easier to keep up alone.

books.title: Introduction to Biblical Hebrew
books.author: Thomas O. Lambdin
books.note: The classic university textbook for classical Hebrew.

books.title: 501 Hebrew Verbs
books.author: Shmuel Bolozky
books.note: A reference rather than a course. Hebrew verbs move in patterns, and this is where you look one up when a pattern will not resolve.

books.title: A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament
books.author: Brown, Driver and Briggs
books.note: The historic scholarly lexicon of biblical Hebrew. Public domain.

books.title: The Oxford English-Hebrew Dictionary
books.author: Doniach and Kahane, editors
books.note: Over fifty thousand entries, English into Hebrew.

books.title: Outline of Hindi Grammar, with Exercises
books.author: R. S. McGregor
books.note: The standard concise academic grammar, with graded exercises and a script introduction.

books.title: The Oxford Hindi-English Dictionary
books.author: R. S. McGregor
books.note: The authoritative dictionary. Also searchable free online.

books.title: Complete Hindi
books.author: Rupert Snell with Simon Weightman
books.note: The best known self-study course, beginner to intermediate.

books.title: Beginner's Hindi Script
books.author: Rupert Snell
books.note: Devanagari on its own terms, one letter group at a time, by the author most Hindi learners in English end up with.

books.title: Hindi
books.author: Yamuna Kachru
books.note: Scholarly descriptive grammar, including a chapter on the script.

books.title: A Primer of Modern Standard Hindi
books.author: Michael C. Shapiro
books.note: Rigorous university course book with extensive script drills.

books.title: Hindi: An Essential Grammar
books.author: Rama Kant Agnihotri
books.note: Learner-focused grammar by a leading Indian linguist.

books.title: Colloquial Hindi: The Complete Course for Beginners
books.author: Tej K. Bhatia
books.note: A full beginner course with audio, transliteration alongside Devanagari for the first half so the script does not stop you on day one.

books.title: A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English
books.author: John T. Platts
books.note: The great historical dictionary of Hindi and Urdu. Free online.

books.title: Elementary Hindi
books.author: Delacy and Joshi
books.note: Modern beginner's course with audio and a companion workbook.
